parts.text: DNA (deoxyribonucleic acid) is the molecule that carries genetic instructions for the development, functioning, growth, and reproduction of all known living organisms and many viruses. It consists of two strands forming a double helix, made of nucleotides containing a sugar, phosphate group, and nitrogenous bases (adenine, thymine, cytosine, guanine). DNA sequences encode genes.
